fusions.name: Tongue Crack
fusions.desc: Snaps your tongue out to 5 tiles, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly-Flop
fusions.desc: You spring onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and land on it, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Coil the Haunches
fusions.desc: Crouch for 1 second, then your damage rises 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Pent-Up Leap
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
